text: For preventing the children of poor people in Ireland, from being a burden on their parents or country, and for making them beneficial to the publick.
zh: 为了防止爱尔兰穷人的孩子成为父母或国家的负担，并让他们造福公众。
chunks: For preventing the children
of poor people in Ireland,
from being a burden
on their parents or country,
and for making them beneficial to the publick.

text: It is a melancholy object to those, who walk through this great town, or travel in the country, when they see the streets, the roads, and cabbin-doors crowded with beggars of the female sex, followed by three, four, or six children, all in rags, and importuning every passenger for an alms.
chunks: It is a melancholy object to those, who walk through this great town,
or travel in the country, when they see the streets,
the roads, and cabbin-doors crowded
with beggars of the female sex, followed by three, four,
or six children, all in rags, and importuning every passenger for an alms.

text: But my intention is very far from being confined to provide only for the children of professed beggars: it is of a much greater extent, and shall take in the whole number of infants at a certain age, who are born of parents in effect as little able to support them, as those who demand our charity in the streets.
chunks: But my intention is very far from being confined to provide only
for the children of professed beggars: it is of a much greater extent, and shall take
in the whole number of infants at a certain age, who are born
of parents in effect as little able to support them, as those
who demand our charity in the streets.

text: As to my own part, having turned my thoughts for many years upon this important subject, and maturely weighed the several schemes of our projectors, I have always found them grossly mistaken in their computation.
zh: 至于我自己，多年来我一直在思考这个重要的主题，并成熟地权衡了我们投影仪的几种方案，我总是发现它们的计算存在严重错误。
chunks: As to my own part,
having turned my thoughts for many years
upon this important subject,
and maturely weighed the several schemes of our projectors,
I have always found them grossly mistaken in their computation.

text: I again subtract fifty thousand, for those women who miscarry, or whose children die by accident or disease within the year.
zh: 我再次减去五万，用于那些在一年内流产的妇女，或者孩子因意外或疾病而死亡的妇女。
chunks: I again subtract fifty thousand,
for those women who miscarry,
or whose children die
by accident or disease
within the year.

text: There only remain a hundred and twenty thousand children of poor parents annually born.
zh: 每年出生的贫困家庭的孩子只剩下十二万。
chunks: There only remain a hundred
and twenty thousand children of poor parents annually born.

text: The question therefore is, How this number shall be reared and provided for? which, as I have already said, under the present situation of affairs, is utterly impossible by all the methods hitherto proposed.
zh: 因此，问题是，如何培养和提供这个数字？正如我已经说过的，在目前的情况下，采用迄今提出的所有方法都是完全不可能的。
chunks: The question therefore is,
How this number shall be reared
and provided for? which, as I have already said,
under the present situation of affairs, is utterly impossible
by all the methods hitherto proposed.

text: I shall now therefore humbly propose my own thoughts, which I hope will not be liable to the least objection.
chunks: I shall now therefore humbly propose my own thoughts,
which I hope will not be liable
to the least objection.

text: London, that a young healthy child well nursed, is, at a year old, a most delicious nourishing and wholesome food, whether stewed, roasted, baked, or boiled; and I make no doubt that it will equally serve in a fricasee, or a ragoust.
zh: 伦敦，一个健康的小孩子，经过良好的护理，一岁时，无论是炖、烤、烤还是煮，都是最美味、最营养、最有益健康的食物；我毫不怀疑它同样可以用于炖菜或肉酱。
chunks: London, that a young healthy child well nursed,
is, at a year old, a most delicious nourishing and wholesome food,
whether stewed, roasted, baked, or boiled;
and I make no doubt that it will equally serve
in a fricasee, or a ragoust.

text: That the remaining hundred thousand may, at a year old, be offered in sale to the persons of quality and fortune, through the kingdom, always advising the mother to let them suck plentifully in the last month, so as to render them plump, and fat for a good table.
chunks: That the remaining hundred thousand may, at a year old,
be offered in sale to the persons of quality and fortune, through the kingdom,
always advising the mother to let them suck plentifully
in the last month, so as
to render them plump, and fat for a good table.

text: A child will make two dishes at an entertainment for friends, and when the family dines alone, the fore or hind quarter will make a reasonable dish, and seasoned with a little pepper or salt, will be very good boiled on the fourth day, especially in winter.
chunks: A child will make two dishes at an entertainment for friends,
and when the family dines alone, the fore
or hind quarter will make a reasonable dish,
and seasoned with a little pepper or salt, will be very good boiled
on the fourth day, especially in winter.

text: I have reckoned upon a medium, that a child just born will weigh 12 pounds, and in a solar year, if tolerably nursed, encreaseth to 28 pounds.
zh: 我算过一个媒介，一个刚出生的孩子重12磅，如果护理得当，一个阳历年里，体重会增加到28磅。
chunks: I have reckoned upon a medium,
that a child just born will weigh 12 pounds,
and in a solar year,
if tolerably nursed,
encreaseth to 28 pounds.

text: I grant this food will be somewhat dear, and therefore very proper for landlords, who, as they have already devoured most of the parents, seem to have the best title to the children.
zh: 我承认这种食物有点贵，因此对房东来说非常合适，因为他们已经吃掉了大部分父母，所以他们似乎对孩子们拥有最好的所有权。
chunks: I grant this food will be somewhat dear,
and therefore very proper for landlords, who,
as they have already devoured most of the parents,
seem to have the best title
to the children.

text: Thus the squire will learn to be a good landlord, and grow popular among his tenants, the mother will have eight shillings neat profit, and be fit for work till she produces another child.
zh: 这样，乡绅就会学会做一个好地主，并在佃户中受到欢迎，母亲就会有八先令的纯利润，并适合工作，直到她再生一个孩子。
chunks: Thus the squire will learn to be a good landlord,
and grow popular among his tenants,
the mother will have eight shillings neat profit,
and be fit
for work till she produces another child.

text: Those who are more thrifty (as I must confess the times require) may flay the carcass; the skin of which, artificially dressed, will make admirable gloves for ladies, and summer boots for fine gentlemen.
zh: 那些比较节俭的人（我必须承认时代需要）可能会剥皮。经过人工修饰的皮肤可以为女士们制作令人赞叹的手套，为优雅的绅士制作夏季靴子。
chunks: Those who are more thrifty
(as I must confess the times require) may flay the carcass;
the skin of which, artificially dressed,
will make admirable gloves
for ladies, and summer boots for fine gentlemen.

text: As to our City of Dublin, shambles may be appointed for this purpose, in the most convenient parts of it, and butchers we may be assured will not be wanting; although I rather recommend buying the children alive, and dressing them hot from the knife, as we do roasting pigs.
chunks: As to our City of Dublin, shambles may be appointed for this purpose,
in the most convenient parts of it,
and butchers we may be assured will not be wanting;
although I rather recommend buying the children alive,
and dressing them hot from the knife, as we do roasting pigs.

text: A very worthy person, a true lover of his country, and whose virtues I highly esteem, was lately pleased in discoursing on this matter, to offer a refinement upon my scheme.
zh: 一个非常有价值的人，一个真正热爱他的国家的人，我非常尊重他的美德，他最近很高兴谈论这个问题，对我的计划提出了改进。
chunks: A very worthy person, a true lover of his country,
and whose virtues I highly esteem,
was lately pleased in discoursing
on this matter, to offer a refinement
upon my scheme.

text: American acquaintance assured me from frequent experience, that their flesh was generally tough and lean, like that of our schoolboys, by continual exercise, and their taste disagreeable, and to fatten them would not answer the charge.
zh: 美国人的熟人从经常的经验中向我保证，他们的肉通常又硬又瘦，就像我们的学生一样，通过不断的锻炼，他们的味道令人讨厌，让他们增肥并不能解决这个指控。
chunks: American acquaintance assured me from frequent experience,
that their flesh was generally tough and lean, like that
of our schoolboys, by continual exercise,
and their taste disagreeable,
and to fatten them would not answer the charge.

text: Neither indeed can I deny, that if the same use were made of several plump young girls in this town, who without one single groat to their fortunes, cannot stir abroad without a chair, and appear at a playhouse and assemblies in foreign fineries which they never will pay for, the kingdom would not be the worse.
chunks: Neither indeed can I deny, that if the same use were made
of several plump young girls in this town,
who without one single groat to their fortunes, cannot stir abroad
without a chair, and appear at a playhouse and assemblies in foreign fineries
which they never will pay for, the kingdom would not be the worse.

text: Some persons of a desponding spirit are in great concern about that vast number of poor people, who are aged, diseased, or maimed; and I have been desired to employ my thoughts what course may be taken, to ease the nation of so grievous an incumbrance.
chunks: Some persons of a desponding spirit are in great concern about that vast number
of poor people, who are aged, diseased, or maimed;
and I have been desired
to employ my thoughts what course may be taken,
to ease the nation of so grievous an incumbrance.

text: But I am not in the least pain upon that matter, because it is very well known, that they are every day dying, and rotting, by cold and famine, and filth, and vermin, as fast as can be reasonably expected.
zh: 但我对此一点也不感到痛苦，因为众所周知，它们每天都在因寒冷、饥荒、污秽和害虫而死亡、腐烂，其速度之快是可以合理预期的。
chunks: But I am not in the least pain upon that matter,
because it is very well known,
that they are every day dying,
and rotting, by cold and famine, and filth,
and vermin, as fast as can be reasonably expected.

text: And as to the young labourers, they are now in almost as hopeful a condition.
zh: 至于年轻的劳工，他们现在的处境几乎同样充满希望。
chunks: And as
to the young labourers,
they are now
in almost
as hopeful a condition.

text: They cannot get work, and consequently pine away from want of nourishment, to a degree, that if at any time they are accidentally hired to common labour, they have not strength to perform it, and thus the country and themselves are happily delivered from the evils to come.
chunks: They cannot get work, and consequently pine away
from want of nourishment, to a degree, that if
at any time they are accidentally hired to common labour, they have not strength
to perform it, and thus the country
and themselves are happily delivered from the evils to come.

text: I have too long digressed, and therefore shall return to my subject.
zh: 我已经离题太久了，所以回到我的主题。
chunks: I have too long digressed,
and therefore shall return
to my subject.

text: I think the advantages by the proposal which I have made are obvious and many, as well as of the highest importance.
zh: 我认为我提出的建议的优点是显而易见的、很多的，而且是最重要的。
chunks: I think the advantages
by the proposal
which I have made are obvious
and many, as well
as of the highest importance.

text: Pretender, hoping to take their advantage by the absence of so many good Protestants, who have chosen rather to leave their country, than stay at home and pay tithes against their conscience to an episcopal curate.
zh: 觊觎者希望利用这么多优秀新教徒缺席的机会，这些新教徒宁愿离开自己的国家，也不愿呆在家里，违背良心向主教牧师缴纳什一税。
chunks: Pretender, hoping to take their advantage
by the absence of so many good Protestants,
who have chosen rather to leave their country,
than stay at home and pay tithes against their conscience
to an episcopal curate.

text: Secondly, The poorer tenants will have something valuable of their own, which by law may be made liable to a distress, and help to pay their landlord’s rent, their corn and cattle being already seized, and money a thing unknown.
zh: 其次，较贫穷的佃户将拥有自己的一些有价值的东西，根据法律，这些东西可能会陷入困境，并帮助支付房东的租金，他们的玉米和牲畜已经被没收，而金钱则是未知的东西。
chunks: Secondly, The poorer tenants will have something valuable
of their own, which by law may be made liable
to a distress, and help
to pay their landlord’s rent, their corn
and cattle being already seized, and money a thing unknown.

text: And the money will circulate among our selves, the goods being entirely of our own growth and manufacture.
zh: 金钱将在我们内部流通，商品完全是我们自己种植和制造的。
chunks: And the money will circulate
among our selves,
the goods being entirely
of our own growth
and manufacture.

text: Fourthly, The constant breeders, besides the gain of eight shillings sterling per annum by the sale of their children, will be rid of the charge of maintaining them after the first year.
zh: 第四，持续饲养者除了每年通过出售孩子获得八先令英镑的收益外，在第一年后将免除维持孩子的费用。
chunks: Fourthly, The constant breeders, besides the gain
of eight shillings sterling per annum
by the sale of their children,
will be rid of the charge
of maintaining them after the first year.

text: Sixthly, This would be a great inducement to marriage, which all wise nations have either encouraged by rewards, or enforced by laws and penalties.
zh: 第六，这将是婚姻的巨大诱因，所有明智的国家要么通过奖励来鼓励婚姻，要么通过法律和惩罚来强制执行。
chunks: Sixthly, This would be a great inducement
to marriage,
which all wise nations have either encouraged
by rewards, or enforced
by laws and penalties.

text: It would encrease the care and tenderness of mothers towards their children, when they were sure of a settlement for life to the poor babes, provided in some sort by the publick, to their annual profit instead of expence.
zh: 当母亲们确信公众会以某种方式为这些可怜的婴儿提供终生的解决方案时，这将增加母亲们对孩子的关心和温柔，使她们每年受益而不是花费。
chunks: It would encrease the care
and tenderness of mothers towards their children,
when they were sure of a settlement for life
to the poor babes, provided in some sort by the publick,
to their annual profit instead of expence.

text: We should soon see an honest emulation among the married women, which of them could bring the fattest child to the market.
zh: 我们很快就会看到已婚妇女之间诚实的竞争，谁能把最胖的孩子带到市场上。
chunks: We should soon see an honest emulation
among the married women,
which of them could bring the fattest child
to the market.

text: Men would become as fond of their wives, during the time of their pregnancy, as they are now of their mares in foal, their cows in calf, or sows when they are ready to farrow; nor offer to beat or kick them (as is too frequent a practice) for fear of a miscarriage.
chunks: Men would become as fond of their wives, during the time
of their pregnancy, as they are now of their mares in foal, their cows
in calf, or sows when they are ready
to farrow; nor offer to beat or kick them
(as is too frequent a practice) for fear of a miscarriage.

text: Many other advantages might be enumerated.
zh: 还可以列举许多其他优点。
chunks: Many other advantages
might be enumerated.

text: But this, and many others, I omit, being studious of brevity.
zh: 但为了简洁起见，我省略了这一点以及许多其他内容。
chunks: But this,
and many others,
I omit,
being studious
of brevity.

text: Dublin would take off annually about twenty thousand carcasses; and the rest of the kingdom (where probably they will be sold somewhat cheaper) the remaining eighty thousand.
zh: 都柏林每年都会带走大约两万具尸体；以及王国的其他地区（可能会以更便宜的价格出售）剩余的八万。
chunks: Dublin would take off annually
about twenty thousand carcasses;
and the rest
of the kingdom
(where probably they will be sold somewhat cheaper) the remaining eighty thousand.

text: I can think of no one objection, that will possibly be raised against this proposal, unless it should be urged, that the number of people will be thereby much lessened in the kingdom.
zh: 我想不出有人会反对这一提议，除非有人敦促王国的人口数量将因此大大减少。
chunks: I can think of no one objection,
that will possibly be raised against this proposal,
unless it should be urged, that the number
of people will be thereby much lessened
in the kingdom.

text: This I freely own, and was indeed one principal design in offering it to the world.
zh: 这是我自由拥有的，并且确实是向世界提供它的主要设计之一。
chunks: This I freely own,
and was indeed one principal design
in offering it
to the world.

text: I think, ever can be upon Earth.
chunks: I think,
ever can be
upon Earth.

text: Therefore I repeat, let no man talk to me of these and the like expedients, till he hath at least some glympse of hope, that there will ever be some hearty and sincere attempt to put them into practice.
zh: 因此我再说一遍，不要让任何人对我谈论这些和类似的权宜之计，除非他至少有一丝希望，即永远会有一些热诚和真诚的尝试将它们付诸实践。
chunks: Therefore I repeat, let no man talk to me of these
and the like expedients, till he hath
at least some glympse of hope,
that there will ever be some hearty
and sincere attempt to put them into practice.

text: For this kind of commodity will not bear exportation, and flesh being of too tender a consistence, to admit a long continuance in salt, although perhaps I could name a country, which would be glad to eat up our whole nation without it.
zh: 因为这种商品不适合出口，而且肉质太嫩，不允许长时间加盐，尽管也许我可以说出一个国家的名字，它会很高兴在没有盐的情况下吃掉我们整个国家。
chunks: For this kind of commodity will not bear exportation,
and flesh being of too tender a consistence,
to admit a long continuance in salt,
although perhaps I could name a country, which would be glad
to eat up our whole nation without it.

text: After all, I am not so violently bent upon my own opinion, as to reject any offer, proposed by wise men, which shall be found equally innocent, cheap, easy, and effectual.
zh: 毕竟，我并没有那么强烈地坚持自己的观点，以至于拒绝智者提出的任何提议，这些提议将被发现同样天真、廉价、容易和有效。
chunks: After all, I am not
so violently bent upon my own opinion,
as to reject any offer, proposed by wise men,
which shall be found equally innocent, cheap,
easy, and effectual.

text: But before something of that kind shall be advanced in contradiction to my scheme, and offering a better, I desire the author or authors will be pleased maturely to consider two points.
zh: 但在提出与我的计划相矛盾的此类内容并提供更好的方案之前，我希望作者能够成熟地考虑两点。
chunks: But before something of that kind shall be advanced
in contradiction to my scheme,
and offering a better, I desire the author
or authors will be pleased maturely
to consider two points.

text: First, As things now stand, how they will be able to find food and raiment for a hundred thousand useless mouths and backs.
zh: 首先，按照现在的情况，他们将如何为十万个无用的嘴巴和背部找到食物和衣服。
chunks: First, As things now stand,
how they will be able
to find food and raiment
for a hundred thousand useless mouths
and backs.

text: I profess in the sincerity of my heart, that I have not the least personal interest in endeavouring to promote this necessary work, having no other motive than the publick good of my country, by advancing our trade, providing for infants, relieving the poor, and giving some pleasure to the rich.
chunks: I profess in the sincerity of my heart, that I have not the least personal interest
in endeavouring to promote this necessary work, having no other motive
than the publick good of my country,
by advancing our trade, providing for infants, relieving the poor,
and giving some pleasure to the rich.

text: I have no children, by which I can propose to get a single penny; the youngest being nine years old, and my wife past child-bearing.
zh: 我没有孩子，因此我可以提议得到一分钱；最小的九岁，我的妻子已经生育过。
chunks: I have no children,
by which I can propose
to get a single penny;
the youngest being nine years old,
and my wife past child-bearing.
